pre_condition: extra_call_edges is an iterable of supplemental edge records (each with caller and callee attributes) or None/empty. phase_fqns is a collection of FQN strings for functions in the current phase. known_fqns is a collection of all known FQN strings.
post_condition: Returns a pair (by_caller_fqn, by_callsite) of dicts, both never None. by_caller_fqn maps each caller FQN to an ordered list of resolved edge records, each identifying a supplemental call edge from that caller to a callee. An edge appears under a given caller FQN when: the callee FQN is present in known_fqns, the caller has a non-empty fqn matching the caller FQN, and that caller FQN is present in phase_fqns. Edges whose callee FQN is absent from known_fqns are skipped. Edges whose caller FQN is absent from phase_fqns are excluded from by_caller_fqn for that caller. by_callsite maps each valid callsite name (matching the identifier pattern [A-Za-z_]\w*) to an ordered list of resolved edge records reachable via that callsite. An edge appears under a given callsite name when: the callee FQN is present in known_fqns and the callsite name appears in the caller's callsite_names. Callsite names that are not valid identifiers are skipped. A single edge may appear in by_caller_fqn, by_callsite, both, or neither, depending on which of its caller and callsite selectors satisfy the phase and validation criteria. When extra_call_edges is None or empty (falsy), both returned dicts are empty.
